title: Seasonal Accounts Calculation Note — The Restore Payment on an Idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule Account
content:
**Calculation.** A member who asks to have an idle seasonal or irrigation account of Electric Service by Rate Schedule restored is told the restore payment: the amount the member pays on the spot so that the account carries no unpaid balance into the new season.

**Restore payment.** The current account balance of the idle service account, rounded to the cent and never less than zero.

### Worked examples (hypothetical idle accounts)

| Current account balance | Restore payment |
|---|---|
| $412.37 owed | $412.37 |
| $0.00 | $0.00 |
| A credit balance of $20.00 | $0.00 — the payment cannot fall below zero |

### Points of judgement

- The figure is taken from the account balance as it stands when the member asks, on the same idle service account.
- A credit balance does not turn into an amount paid back to the member; the restore payment is simply zero.
